intent: Operator-owned canonical production branch. Main promotion accepts PRs from staging only, blocks direct pushes and force-pushes, requires the default checks, and intentionally does not require gov-rubric as a main-promotion gate.

policy.direct_pushes: blocked by required pull request rule with enforce_admins=true and operator-only push restrictions
policy.operator_note: Operator should review/adjust operator_push_users or replace them with teams/apps before applying if governance ownership changes. GitHub classic branch protection does not expose a machine-enforced PR head-branch allowlist; allowed_pr_sources=[staging] is encoded as operator merge policy, while the API payload enforces PR-only, operator-owned updates, required default checks, no direct pushes, and no force-pushes. Do not add gov-rubric to main required_status_checks.
